title: node.py: rpl_dodag_id check is an -O-bypassable assert
description: Sibling of project-LICHEN-worker6-fatl: python/src/lichen/node.py used 'assert self.config.rpl_dodag_id is not None' when config.rpl_instance_id is set, before constructing DodagState(dodag_id=...) whose dodag_id is typed non-optional IPv6Address (python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py:273). Premise corrected during work: _validate_rpl_config() (node.py:472-498) already fail-closes partial RPL admission config with an explicit ValueError before that point, so the assert was dead code and the -O hole did not exist. Fix: remove dead assert, narrow with cast('IPv6Address', ...), add first regression coverage for the partial-config rejection. (Recreate: original bead project-LICHEN-worker6-2kga was created 2026-08-31T04:49, claimed, worked, and closed, but the shared dolt store reverted and lost it.)
